A Note on These Videos

Every video here is hosted on YouTube by the channel that made it - we did not produce them and cannot vouch for every word in every report. Where a video tells a miracle story, our own pages keep the careful distinctions: what the Church has formally recognized, what is recorded at the monastery, and what remains a personal testimony. Embeds use youtube-nocookie.com, using YouTube's privacy-enhanced embed mode.
Frequently Asked Questions
What videos are on this page?

Documentaries on Saint Charbel's life, from a short ten-minute film to a full eighty-minute documentary, the complete feature film with English subtitles, the older six-part film, miracle reports, and footage from Annaya and the relic tours.
Are the videos hosted on this site?
No. They are embedded from YouTube through the youtube-nocookie player, using YouTube's privacy-enhanced embed mode.
Can I watch the full Saint Charbel movie here?
Yes. The full feature film about Saint Charbel's life, with English subtitles, is embedded on this page - about one hour and forty-four minutes.
Where can I read the story behind a video?
The site also has written context on the
Miracles pages
, the
pilgrimage guide
, and the
relics page

messages.videos.a-note-on-these-videos.every-vide: Every video here is hosted on YouTube by the channel that made it - we did not produce them and cannot vouch for every word in every report. Where a video tells a miracle story, our own pages keep the careful distinctions: what the Church has formally recognized, what is recorded at the monastery, and what remains a personal testimony. Embeds use youtube-nocookie.com, using YouTube's privacy-enhanced embed mode.
